{{Quote|Our most popular salad, featuring crisp Revwien lettuce garnished with topatoes, space-carrots, Qiraadishes, Mandalorian oranges, Sriluurian raisins and Wol Cabasshews. Served with Luptoomian dressing.|Dex's Diner menu, on its interstellar garden salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Luptoomian dressing''' was a type of [[Dressing/Legends|dressing]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Luptoomian/Legends|Luptoomians]], a cultural group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Luptoom]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia - Luptoomian">{{CSWECite|II|267|Luptoomian}}</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dressing]] with its [[interstellar garden salad]]s. The Diner's menu stated that its [[Salad/Legends|salads]] used toppings grown in locally [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[VegSatellite]]s.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luptoomian dressing was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
